invariants.rationale: The method checks for cell != null, and if not null, only continues if cell.getTile() != null, otherwise returns.
The method returns immediately if cell.getTile() is an AnimatedTiledMapTile; so this cannot be true at exit.
All combinations of flips and rotations are handled, but the rotations check is only reached if cell != null and tile != null; expressing a safe access combination.
Color as a float is likely representing packed color/alpha value and is typically non-negative for rendering.

invariants.expression: cell == null || cell.getTile() != null && !(cell.getTile() instanceof AnimatedTiledMapTile)
invariants.rationale: At exit, if cell is not null, cell.getTile() is not null and not AnimatedTiledMapTile, otherwise we would have returned earlier.
